1965-12-06: Behind Ben Monroe's 18 points, New Mexico Lobos defeated Iowa State 56–52. Bob Zingler had 20 for Iowa State.
1965-12-20: Ohio State Buckeyes beat Iowa State 87–70 as Sepic scored a team-high 28. Koch had 34 for Iowa State.
1966-12-03: Ohio State Buckeyes survived Iowa State 79–77 as Howell scored a team-high 20. Smith had 27 for Iowa State. Howell grabbed 17 rebounds.
